import pathlib
src = pathlib.Path('crates/pony-agent-core/src/bin/tui.rs').read_text()
i = src.index('let need_blank = state')
j = src.index('let scroll_total = total.saturating_sub(trailing_blanks);')
seg = src[i:j]
assert 'push_blank(&mut trailing_status_lines);' in seg
assert "let mut trailing_status_lines: Vec<Line<'static>> = Vec::new();" in src
assert 'let from = window_start.saturating_sub(cache_total);' in src
cache_total, visible = 100, 20
def sim(n, off):
    we = min(off + visible, cache_total + n)
    cslice = max(0, min(we, cache_total) - off)
    app = 0
    if we > cache_total:
        fr = max(0, off - cache_total)
        if fr < n:
            app = n - fr
    return cslice, app, cslice + app
for n in (1, 2):
    max_off = cache_total + n - visible
    for off in (max_off, max_off - 1):
        cslice, app, total_render = sim(n, off)
        print('n=%d offset=%d: cache切片=%d + status=%d = %d 行 / 视口 %d 行 %s' % (
            n, off, cslice, app, total_render, visible,
            'OK' if total_render == visible else 'OVERFLOW => 末行(状态行)被裁掉'))
print('CONFIRMED: need_blank 分支的 push_blank 对空 Vec 恒 no-op => n 恒 0/1（状态行上方那行呼吸从未插入）；from 切片未按 window_end 截断，n=2 时 offset=max-1 渲染 21 行进 20 行视口、状态行消失。今天恰好正确只依赖 n<=1 这个隐式不变量')
PY
